title: fix(service-storage)!: the family gate and the route judge the same credential
body:
Fixes #24366

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changed

The storage family's ADR-0069 authentication-policy gate and the route now judge the same credential. The family door fronts routes that serve different credentials — the upload routes and the unclaimed-file download identify their caller by the session, the parent-governed download serves the one request-to-ExecutionContext composition's principal — so the door judges every credential a route of the family can serve. A session the policy HOLDS (an expired password, enforced MFA not yet enrolled) is refused `403` with the gate's posture code on every route of the family, whatever else the request carries, before any of the family's own logic runs. A held key's owner is still refused through the shared key-admission seam with the owner's posture.

The fix is one narrowing in `buildAuthGateSessionReader` (`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts`): the gate the door asks now always covers the credential the route will serve.

## Why it is a narrowing

No request a storage route refuses today becomes accepted: this only adds refusals (a held session that was served is now refused). No export, schema or accepted value changes. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

## Scope

- `packages/services/service-storage` only. `packages/core` / `packages/runtime` (the one composition `resolveRequestExecutionContext`) are untouched — this is a `service-storage`-local decision.
- The gate reader stays a hand-written door fact beside the one composition (it is the input #23217's item 3 waits on; see below), implemented here as a parity pin rather than a gate-only mode of the composition.

- Docs (patch round 1, rework `6253965841`): `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` now says that the storage routes refuse a gated session whatever else the request carries. This PR made the earlier sentence false there.
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` records the new pin's fake engine, written by the gate's own `--write`.

## Tests

- New pin `storage-routes.family-gate-credential.pin.test.ts`: on the download routes (an unclaimed file and a parent-governed file) and the upload start route, a held session is refused `403` with its posture whatever else the request carries, storage never touched. Controls: an un-held session is served; a held owner's key alone is refused as today.
- Updated the two existing pins that encoded the prior door behaviour (`storage-routes.api-key-account-posture.pin.test.ts`, `storage-routes.request-context-door.pin.test.ts`) to the rule.
- Ablation: restoring the prior reader turns three of the new pin's cases red; restored clean.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test` (1051 pass) and `typecheck` green locally; the derived gate families run in CI.

## Bearing on #23217

This card's design is #23217 item 3's input: the storage family's gate reader stays a hand-written door fact (a parity pin), not a gate-only mode of the one composition.
